_readme: EVB Lite protocol profile TEMPLATE. Nothing in this file is verified.
Copy to config/evb_profile.json and fill in ONLY behavior you have observed on the
physical EVB Lite or confirmed in EVident documentation. Leave unknown values null.
Then set verified=true, fill verified_by / verified_on / source_of_truth, and press
'Reload EVB profile' in the operator dashboard. See docs/evb-lite-integration.md.

status._comment: Optional GET path that returns device status as JSON, plus dotted paths to fields in it.

capture._comment: Optional documented requests to start/stop streaming or recording. Non-GET requests REQUIRE documented_in.

samples._comment: GET path that returns recent samples. Polled every poll_interval_ms.

json._comment: list_path: dotted path to the sample list ('' = root). layout: objects | arrays | columns.

_axis_map_comment: Map lander axes to sensor axes so +z points UP when the lander rests upright, e.g. {"z": "-y"}.
